summary: Generated a public llms.txt for the maintained Node.js Undici documentation website with Sourcey 3.6.5, verified six live targets, and opened upstream pull request nodejs/undici-website#18.
observations: sourcey_version: sourcey@3.6.5, pinned exactly in package.json and package-lock.json
sourcey_command: npm ci && npm run build:fetch-docs && npm run build:html && npm run build:llms

generation_proof: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/centwright/undici-website/f1f7ea3baa92ebffe13970ebcbe3aecc5201c9a6/scripts/build-llms.mjs invokes Sourcey's installed CLI and then deterministically maps generated links to the website's case-sensitive routes; llms.txt was not hand-written

public_url: https://undici-website-git-fork-centwright-codex-sourcey-llms-openjs.vercel.app/llms.txt (OpenJS Foundation Vercel deployment for upstream PR #18; byte-identical to the sealed Sourcey-generated artifact)
audit_2: https://undici-website.vercel.app/getting-started.html returned HTTP 200 and resolved to /getting-started
audit_4: https://undici-website.vercel.app/api/Agent.html returned HTTP 200 and resolved to the case-sensitive /api/Agent route
audit_5: https://undici-website.vercel.app/api/Fetch.html returned HTTP 200 and resolved to the case-sensitive /api/Fetch route
audit_6: https://undici-website.vercel.app/api/WebSocket.html returned HTTP 200 and resolved to the case-sensitive /api/WebSocket route
